Key Responsibilities

Do you enjoy building clear, defensible factual records from large volumes of documents and data?

Are you motivated to use legal technology and AI tools to improve discovery and document-review workflows?

We are looking for a Paralegal - Fact Finding Unit to help us:

- Build and maintain comprehensive factual records and narratives for civil litigation, regulatory investigations, and similar matters
- Organize and manage matter files, document repositories, and evidence records across electronic and hard-copy formats
- Prepare and assemble chronologies, exhibits, witness files, and interview materials to support attorney-led fact finding
- Coordinate document collection, processing, tracking, and production with internal partners, IT teams, and external vendors
- Support document review quality control, including document organization, privilege log support, and production readiness checks
- Use litigation support and AI tools to improve information retrieval, document management, and workflow efficiency

The team

The Fact Finding Unit sits within Global Litigation, part of UBS's Group Legal function, and supports matters across all regions and business divisions.

The unit supports litigation, regulatory, enforcement, and other high-risk matters by developing factual records, managing discovery and document review processes, organizing evidence, and leveraging legal technology and AI tools to support fact development.

Your Skills And Experience

To succeed in this role, you bring:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
- At least 5 years of work as a litigation paralegal, investigations paralegal, or comparable legal support role
- Strong knowledge of discovery processes, document management, and matter organization
- Ability to manage multiple matters and competing deadlines with high attention to detail
- Proficiency with litigation support and AI-enabled tools (e.g., Relativity, Microsoft Copilot) to improve legal workflows
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
- Ideally have hands-on support for document review and production workflows, including quality control and privilege log support
- Ideally have background in financial services, regulatory matters, or an in-house legal department
- You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use
